# План исправлений

Область: только каталог slopdns; сохранить API, DNS и формат синхронизации. Не менять соседние проекты и пользовательские данные.

1. Исправить повышение zone → org/service-account в общем RBAC и проверку организации назначения при переносе.
2. Устранить гонку проверки owner при изменении/удалении role binding, включая trusted revoke.
3. Добавить ограничение запросов до интроспекции и публичного входа; общий атомарный бюджет второго фактора по пользователю между challenge и чувствительными операциями.
4. Проверить DNS-бинарник и sync, строгую валидацию RDATA; исправить подтверждённые проблемы без удаления GPT/DNS-функциональности.
5. Добавить генерацию уникальных установочных секретов и рекомендации по TLS/ротации без отключения штатного CTF HTTP.
6. Регрессионные тесты, сборка, независимый повторный аудит; отчёт на русском с доказательствами и ограничениями.

Приёмка: запрещены повышение полномочий и перенос в неавторизованную организацию; легитимное наследование org → ресурс работает; owner не удаляется гонкой; MFA-бюджет не сбрасывается новым challenge; DNS/GPT и API сохраняют совместимость. Проверить go test/go vet, сборку и доступные интеграционные тесты. Не утверждать отсутствие всех уязвимостей без достаточной проверки бинарника.

name: slopdns

x-app: &app
  user: "65532:65532"
  restart: unless-stopped
  security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true

  user: "65532:65532"
  restart: "no"
  security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true

x-health: &health

  timeout: 3s
  retries: 6
  start_period: 60s
  start_interval: 1s

x-zone-env: &zone-env

  ZONE_NAMESERVERS: ${ZONE_NAMESERVERS:-ns1.slopdns.slop.}
  SOA_MNAME: ${SOA_MNAME:-ns1.slopdns.slop.}
  SOA_RNAME: ${SOA_RNAME:-hostmaster.slopdns.slop.}
  RESERVED_ZONE_NAMES: ${RESERVED_ZONE_NAMES:-}

x-pki-done: &pki-done
  condition: service_completed_successfully

x-postgres-healthy: &postgres-healthy
  condition: service_healthy

services:
  pki-init:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: tools/Dockerfile
      target: pkigen
    user: "65532:65532"
    restart: "no"
    network_mode: none
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    environment:
      PKI_DIR: /pki
      DNS_NODE_ID: dns1
    volumes:
      - pki:/pki

  postgres:
    image: postgres:17
    restart: unless-stopped
    shm_size: 128m
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: slopdns
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in deploy/.env}
      SLOPDNS_IAM_OWNER_DB_PASSWORD: ${SLOPDNS_IAM_OWNER_DB_PASSWORD:?set SLOPDNS_IAM_OWNER_DB_PASSWORD in deploy/.env}
      SLOPDNS_BACKEND_OWNER_DB_PASSWORD: ${SLOPDNS_BACKEND_OWNER_DB_PASSWORD:?set SLOPDNS_BACKEND_OWNER_DB_PASSWORD in deploy/.env}
      SLOPDNS_IAM_DB_PASSWORD: ${SLOPDNS_IAM_DB_PASSWORD:?set SLOPDNS_IAM_DB_PASSWORD in deploy/.env}
      SLOPDNS_BACKEND_DB_PASSWORD: ${SLOPDNS_BACKEND_DB_PASSWORD:?set SLOPDNS_BACKEND_DB_PASSWORD in deploy/.env}
      SLOPDNS_SYNC_DB_PASSWORD: ${SLOPDNS_SYNC_DB_PASSWORD:?set SLOPDNS_SYNC_DB_PASSWORD in deploy/.env}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./postgres/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql:ro
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-q", "-h", "127.0.0.1", "-U", "postgres", "-d", "slopdns"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 60s
      start_interval: 1s
    depends_on:
      pki-init: *pki-done

  iam-migrate:
    <<: *job
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: web/iam/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    command: ["migrate"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://slopdns_iam_owner:${SLOPDNS_IAM_OWNER_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/slopdns?sslmode=disable
    networks:
      - internal
    depends_on:
      postgres: *postgres-healthy

  backend-migrate:
    <<: *job
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: web/backend/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    command: ["migrate"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://slopdns_backend_owner:${SLOPDNS_BACKEND_OWNER_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/slopdns?sslmode=disable
    networks:
      - internal
    depends_on:
      postgres: *postgres-healthy

  backend-bootstrap:
    <<: *job
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: web/backend/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    command: ["bootstrap-infra"]
    environment:
      <<: *zone-env
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://slopdns_backend:${SLOPDNS_BACKEND_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/slopdns?sslmode=disable
      MIGRATE_ON_START: "false"
      INFRA_NS_ADDRESS: ${INFRA_NS_ADDRESS:?set INFRA_NS_ADDRESS in deploy/.env}
    networks:
      - internal
    depends_on:
      postgres: *postgres-healthy
      backend-migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

  iam:
    <<: *app
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: web/iam/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    command: ["serve"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://slopdns_iam:${SLOPDNS_IAM_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/slopdns?sslmode=disable
      MIGRATE_ON_START: "false"
      PKI_DIR: /pki
      GRPC_ADDR: ":9090"
      BACKEND_GRPC_ADDR: backend:9090
      SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE: ${SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE:-false}
      ARGON2_MAX_CONCURRENCY: ${ARGON2_MAX_CONCURRENCY:-2}
      ARGON2_QUEUE_TIMEOUT: ${ARGON2_QUEUE_TIMEOUT:-2s}
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: pki
        target: /pki
        read_only: true
        volume:
          subpath: iam
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      <<: *health
      test: ["CMD", "iam", "healthcheck"]
    depends_on:
      pki-init: *pki-done
      postgres: *postgres-healthy
      iam-migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

  backend:
    <<: *app
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: web/backend/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    command: ["serve"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://slopdns_backend:${SLOPDNS_BACKEND_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/slopdns?sslmode=disable
      MIGRATE_ON_START: "false"
      PKI_DIR: /pki
      GRPC_ADDR: ":9090"
      IAM_GRPC_ADDR: iam:9090
      <<: *zone-env
      MAX_ZONES_PER_ORG: ${MAX_ZONES_PER_ORG:-50}
      MAX_RECORDS_PER_ZONE: ${MAX_RECORDS_PER_ZONE:-1000}
      MAX_ORGS_PER_USER: ${MAX_ORGS_PER_USER:-20}
      MAX_PENDING_INVITATIONS_PER_ORG: ${MAX_PENDING_INVITATIONS_PER_ORG:-100}
      MAX_ZONE_BYTES: ${MAX_ZONE_BYTES:-4194304}
      AUTHZ_CACHE_SIZE: ${AUTHZ_CACHE_SIZE:-10000}
      AUTHZ_CACHE_TTL: ${AUTHZ_CACHE_TTL:-5m}
      CHANGE_LOG_RETENTION: ${CHANGE_LOG_RETENTION:-24h}
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: pki
        target: /pki
        read_only: true
        volume:
          subpath: backend
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      <<: *health
      test: ["CMD", "backend", "healthcheck"]
    depends_on:
      pki-init: *pki-done
      postgres: *postgres-healthy
      backend-migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      backend-bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

  dns-sync:
    <<: *app
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: web/dnssync/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    command: ["serve"]
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://slopdns_sync:${SLOPDNS_SYNC_DB_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/slopdns?sslmode=disable
      PKI_DIR: /pki
      DNS_NODE_IDS: dns1
      GRPC_ADDR: ":9443"
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: pki
        target: /pki
        read_only: true
        volume:
          subpath: dns-sync
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      <<: *health
      test: ["CMD", "dns-sync", "healthcheck"]
    depends_on:
      pki-init: *pki-done
      postgres: *postgres-healthy
      backend-migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      backend-bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

  gateway:
    <<: *app
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: web/gateway/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    command: ["serve"]
    environment:
      PKI_DIR: /pki
      IAM_GRPC_ADDR: iam:9090
      IAM_HTTP_URL: http://iam:8080
      BACKEND_HTTP_URL: http://backend:8080
      RATE_LIMIT_RPS: ${RATE_LIMIT_RPS:-50}
      RATE_LIMIT_BURST: ${RATE_LIMIT_BURST:-100}
      MAX_BODY_BYTES: ${MAX_BODY_BYTES:-1048576}
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: pki
        target: /pki
        read_only: true
        volume:
          subpath: gateway
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      <<: *health
      test: ["CMD", "gateway", "healthcheck"]
    depends_on:
      pki-init: *pki-done
      iam:
        condition: service_healthy

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: web/frontend/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    user: "101:101"
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    ports:
      - "${HTTP_PORT:-80}:8080"
    networks:
      public:
        gw_priority: 1
      internal: {}
    healthcheck:
      <<: *health
      start_period: 20s
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-q", "-O", "/dev/null", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz"]

  dns-server:
    <<: *app
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: dns-server/Dockerfile
      target: runtime
      args:
        DEBIAN_MIRROR: ${DEBIAN_MIRROR:-http://mirror.yandex.ru}
    command: ["serve"]
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    environment:
      PKI_DIR: /pki
      DNS_NODE_ID: dns1
      DNS_PORT: "53"
      HEALTH_ADDR: ":8080"
      SYNC_ADDR: dns-sync:9443
      SYNC_LEASE: ${SYNC_LEASE:-300s}
      LOG_LEVEL: ${DNS_LOG_LEVEL:-info}
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: pki
        target: /pki
        read_only: true
        volume:
          subpath: dns-server
    ports:
      - "${DNS_BIND_IP:-0.0.0.0}:${DNS_HOST_PORT:-8053}:53/udp"
      - "${DNS_BIND_IP:-0.0.0.0}:${DNS_HOST_PORT:-8053}:53/tcp"
    networks:
      public:
        gw_priority: 1
      internal: {}
    healthcheck:
      <<: *health
      test: ["CMD", "dns-server", "healthcheck"]
    depends_on:
      pki-init: *pki-done
      dns-sync:
        condition: service_healthy

networks:
  public: {}
  internal:
    internal: true

volumes:
  pgdata: {}
  pki: {}

## Review

- **Correct:** RBAC now restricts resource roles to matching type, ID and organization while preserving organization inheritance (`web/pkg/rbac/rbac.go:188–208`). Transfer acceptance checks the actual destination organization (`web/backend/internal/core/transfers.go:190`).
- **Correct:** Both preauthentication budgets execute before public upstream requests or introspection (`web/gateway/internal/proxy/proxy.go:165–183`). Bucket counts are capped without resetting active budgets (`web/gateway/internal/ratelimit/ratelimit.go:60–66`).
- **Correct:** Trusting `X-Real-IP` matches the reviewed deployment: nginx overwrites it (`web/frontend/nginx.conf:133`), and the gateway has no published port in `deploy/compose.yaml`.

- **Note — Medium, availability:** `web/gateway/internal/proxy/proxy.go:166–172` consumes the global budget **before** rejecting an exhausted IP. One client can therefore exhaust the shared budget using requests already denied by its own limit. Deterministic example with IP burst 1/global burst 2: A succeeds; A is IP-limited but consumes the second global token; unrelated B receives 429. Check the IP budget first and add this cross-client regression test.

- **Note — Important missing regression:** `web/backend/internal/authz/authz_test.go:8–19` tests `OrgRole`, not `AcceptTransfer`. Reintroducing the original erroneous `highestOwnedOrg` call would still pass this test. Add a backend transfer test proving ownership of organization A cannot authorize transfer into B, asserting the transfer and zone remain unchanged; also cover legitimate destination admin acceptance.
- **Note — Missing integration coverage:** Current gateway tests call `serve` directly. Add coverage through `New` and the actual reverse proxy, plus nginx verification that spoofed/duplicate `X-Real-IP` values are overwritten. Explicit `/auth/login/totp` prelimit coverage is also absent.

## Review

- **Correct:** RBAC now restricts resource roles to matching type, ID and organization while preserving organization inheritance (`web/pkg/rbac/rbac.go:188–208`). Transfer acceptance checks the actual destination organization (`web/backend/internal/core/transfers.go:190`).
- **Correct:** Both preauthentication budgets execute before public upstream requests or introspection (`web/gateway/internal/proxy/proxy.go:165–183`). Bucket counts are capped without resetting active budgets (`web/gateway/internal/ratelimit/ratelimit.go:60–66`).
- **Correct:** Trusting `X-Real-IP` matches the reviewed deployment: nginx overwrites it (`web/frontend/nginx.conf:133`), and the gateway has no published port in `deploy/compose.yaml`.

- **Note — Medium, availability:** `web/gateway/internal/proxy/proxy.go:166–172` consumes the global budget **before** rejecting an exhausted IP. One client can therefore exhaust the shared budget using requests already denied by its own limit. Deterministic example with IP burst 1/global burst 2: A succeeds; A is IP-limited but consumes the second global token; unrelated B receives 429. Check the IP budget first and add this cross-client regression test.

- **Note — Important missing regression:** `web/backend/internal/authz/authz_test.go:8–19` tests `OrgRole`, not `AcceptTransfer`. Reintroducing the original erroneous `highestOwnedOrg` call would still pass this test. Add a backend transfer test proving ownership of organization A cannot authorize transfer into B, asserting the transfer and zone remain unchanged; also cover legitimate destination admin acceptance.
- **Note — Missing integration coverage:** Current gateway tests call `serve` directly. Add coverage through `New` and the actual reverse proxy, plus nginx verification that spoofed/duplicate `X-Real-IP` values are overwritten. Explicit `/auth/login/totp` prelimit coverage is also absent.

**Validation:** Offline full Go tests, scoped race tests and scoped vet passed. PostgreSQL integration tests skipped because `SLOPDNS_TEST_DATABASE_URL` was unset. No source edits. Requested `plan.md`/`progress.md` were absent; reviewed `SECURITY_PLAN.md`. Deliberate CTF HTTP is not flagged.
